dog.description_text: Hi, I'm Oates, and at just 2 months old I'm a little black bundle of charm! 🐾 I'm a female Domestic Shorthair with a striking black coat, a classic van pattern, and a 3.5 lb frame, and I'm already spayed. I'm affectionate, friendly, and gentle, with a playful, mischievous streak that keeps things lively! 😺 I'm looking for a loving home where I can grow up and become your loyal little shadow, so come meet me at the shelter today because I can't wait to steal your heart! 💕
dog.name: Oates
